title: EmDash personalization preserves technical enums and translates every mapped repeater label
steps: Collect page and repeater labels containing state/status enums alongside state_label/status_text. Apply deterministic translated labels to the collected fields.

Rewrite the actual Base seed home features_items, onepage product_parts, landing features_cards, product carousel_slides and tabs_tabs using their actual personalization map and deterministic model responses; preserve unrelated fields.
Rewrite the form on a Vietnamese root, including helpText on both a business-briefed name field and an unbriefed consent field.
expect: Technical success/warning and publication status values are never offered for translation; visible state/status labels are translated.
Every mapped kicker, title, text, CTA, tab and link label is rewritten; URLs and unrelated data remain byte-equivalent.
Both help texts translate, the briefed field retains its own label, and the consent field stays required.
evidence: tasks/evidence/akemi-user-acceptance-2026-10-13/emdash-base-enum-write-failures-before.json: real German build rejected complete page updates because hero_aside_state had been translated outside the schema enum.
fence: Deterministic regression using the real tool and Base seed/map. Real model and HTTP Content API acceptance is recorded separately.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=technical state enums|home benefit cards|a root written in Vietnamese
